med-hist-01-c2.text: University of Chicago News Office. Origins of writing make for engaging new exhibition at Oriental Institute Museum. University of Chicago News.
med-hist-01-c2.quote: There are four instances and places in human history when writing was invented from scratch.
med-hist-01-c2.claim: it was invented independently at least three or four times: in Sumer around 3200 BCE (cuneiform on clay)
